title: A cache node dies
question: When one of five cache nodes crashes, how much of the cache is lost with it?
explain: With mod-N placement, a key's node is hash(key) mod N, so going from 5 nodes to 4 reassigns about 80% of keys and every one of them misses at once. A consistent-hash ring with 160 virtual points per node only reassigns the dead node's own keys, about 20%.
